'''Gort's Casino''' was a location on<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Hey, this isn't Gort's Casino!|A possible line by the bounty hunter|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Gort's Casino was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released in [[2011]]. Optional dialogue in the game allows the player character in the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] storyline to mention the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] while feigning surprise upon entering the [[Ugnaught Clan Warehouse]] in the [[Duros Sector]] of Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TOR" />
